paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: BESIII search for ALP a->gamma gamma in J/psi radiative decays. Mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV/c^2. Most stringent gaggamma limit for 0.165-1.468 GeV. Only one explicit numerical coupling value given in text: gaggamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 excluded for ma ~ 0.25 GeV (=2.5e8 eV). Full exclusion curve is in Fig. 6 but individual numerical points not tabulated; the single text-extractable point is provided. This is a collider/decay bound (not a DM haloscope), so no DM density assumed.
